advisory.finding: The ticket-id token is extracted as the first non-dash argument (`next((arg for arg in rest if not arg.startswith('-')), None)`). Several allowlisted commands take value-bearing options (edit --title/--priority/--assignee/--description/--parent, transition --reason/--class/--caused-by/--ref, set-file-impact --none, show/reopen --output). argparse permits options before positionals, so `rebar edit --title Foo <id>` yields rest=['--title','Foo','<id>'] and the heuristic selects 'Foo' — the flag VALUE — not the ticket id. This either silently suppresses the warning or (if the value coincidentally matches another ticket id/alias) warns about the WRONG ticket.
